map.一般纳税人实行抵扣制（销项−进项），税率多为 13%/9%/6%；小规模纳税人按: A general VAT payer uses the credit system (output − input), with tax rates mostly 13%/9%/6%; a small-scale payer applies a simplified calculation of sales × 3% (currently preferential 1%), cannot deduct input VAT but has simpler administration.
map.一般纳税人当月应纳增值税: VAT payable by a general payer in the current month
map.一般纳税人按月核算应纳增值税=当期销项税额−当期进项税额。: A general payer computes the VAT payable monthly = output VAT of the period − input VAT of the period.
map.不含税价与含税价互相换算，快速计算增值税额: Convert between the tax-exclusive and tax-inclusive price and compute the VAT amount quickly
map.增值税是对增值额征税，上游已缴的进项税可在销售时从销项税中扣除，避免对同一个增值: VAT taxes the value added, so input VAT already paid upstream can be deducted from the output VAT at the point of sale, which avoids taxing the same value-added stage twice; input VAT on exempt or non-taxable items may not be deducted.

map.：某商贸企业当月销项税额 13 万元、进项税额 8 万元、上期留抵 1 万元，应: : a trading company has output VAT of 130,000 CNY, input VAT of 80,000 CNY and 10,000 CNY carried over from the previous period, so the VAT payable = 130,000−80,000−10,000 = 40,000 CNY; if the input exceeds the output it becomes a credit carried forward for deduction in the next period.
